title: How Much Does Flood Insurance Cost?
summary: Discover the specifics of flood insurance costs and influencing factors. Gain the knowledge needed to choose the best coverage for your property.
body_text: Flood insurance costs can differ widely depending on where you live, your property’s flood risk, and the type of coverage you choose. On average, flood insurance costs $985 per year. However, exact premium charges may vary based on several factors. It’s advisable to consult reputable insurance companies like Neptune Flood for a personalized flood insurance estimate. Neptune’s residential flood coverage starts as low as $250 per year. What Factors Determine the Cost of Private Flood Insurance? When calculating your flood insurance estimate, insurers like Neptune Flood take into account many variables that reflect your home’s true flood risk and the risk-based cost of insurance. Below are some of the key factors that determine how much you’ll pay for a private flood insurance policy. Property-Specific Factors These elements are tied to your home’s physical characteristics and your personal coverage choices. Coverage You Desire The level of protection you choose significantly affects your premium. For example, a $250,000 policy will naturally cost more than a $100,000 policy. Neptune Flood offers comprehensive flood insurance options that fit different budgets and coverage needs. Type of Home or Building The construction type and foundation of your home (e.g., slab foundation vs. crawlspace) influence the risk of flood damage . Homes built on elevated foundations often benefit from lower flood insurance costs. Age of the Home or Building Newer homes typically qualify for lower flood insurance rates, since they often comply with modern building codes that mitigate flood risk. Elevation Above Sea Level (Base Flood Elevation) Homes built higher above base flood elevation usually receive lower flood insurance premiums because they face less flood exposure. Deductible Amount Choosing a higher deductible can lower your flood insurance rate, but it also increases your out-of-pocket expenses if you file a flood insurance claim. Location-Specific Factors These are tied to where your home is situated and the surrounding environmental and regulatory conditions. Flood Zone Designation Homes located in high-risk flood zones (Special Flood Hazard Areas) generally pay higher premiums than those in non-SFHA zones. You can identify your zone using FEMA’s flood maps. State and Federal Flood Insurance Requirements Some lenders require NFIP flood insurance in designated zones, but private flood insurance companies like Neptune Flood provide valid alternatives that meet those same standards. Past Flooding History Properties that have experienced frequent flooding or prior flood insurance claims are typically viewed as higher risk, leading to higher premiums. Natural Disaster Risk Areas Homes located in regions prone to hurricanes, heavy storms, or coastal flooding often face higher risk-based costs of insurance, reflecting their true flood risk. Pro Tip: To lower your flood insurance rates, consider implementing flood mitigation measures such as installing flood openings or elevating your home. Average Flood Insurance Costs by Zone Flood insurance rates vary by FEMA flood zone and state-specific flood risks, with coastal and inland high-risk areas generally seeing higher premiums. Understanding your zone designation can help you determine your true flood risk and the risk-based cost of insurance for your home. Do I Need Flood Insurance if I am not in a High-Risk Zone? Absolutely. Many homeowners are surprised to learn that flood insurance isn’t only for those in high-risk flood zones. If your property is in a Special Flood Hazard Area (SFHA), your lender will likely require coverage. However, even homes in moderate or low-risk areas can experience flooding from heavy rainfall, drainage issues, or sudden storms. In fact, about 30% of all flood claims come from properties outside Special Flood Hazard Areas. Homeowners with valuable assets or active mortgages should strongly consider a private flood insurance policy for added protection. How Can You Save Money on Flood Insurance Coverage? While flood insurance is essential for protecting your home, there are several proven ways to reduce your premium, especially when purchasing from private insurers: Compare Private vs. NFIP Rates: Private flood insurance policies often offer more flexible coverage and competitive rates compared to the National Flood Insurance Program (NFIP). Shopping around can help you find a policy that fits your budget without sacrificing protection. Increase Your Deductible: Choosing a higher deductible can lower your annual premium. Make sure it’s an amount you can comfortably pay in case of a claim. Learn more about flood insurance deductibles . Improve Your Property’s Flood Resilience: Simple upgrades like flood vents, elevating utilities, or landscaping adjustments can reduce risk and help lower your insurance costs over time. How to Choose the Right Flood Insurance Policy? Selecting the right protection is essential for adequate security. While several factors affect cost, understanding your needs will help you make an informed decision: Evaluate Coverage Needs: Assess the value of your home and personal belongings to ensure the policy meets your requirements. Understand Policy Types: Plans typically include building coverage (structure) and personal property coverage (belongings). Consider Additional Options: Neptune offers extra protections not available through the NFIP, such as Temporary Living Expenses or Pool Repair. Review the Insurer’s Reputation: Research customer feedback to ensure reliable service during claims. Why Do You Need to Know Your Flood Insurance Estimate? For those in high-risk flood zones, it’s important to understand the flood insurance cost and how flood insurance covers damage. It is crucial for several reasons: Plan Ahead: Knowing your flood insurance cost in advance allows you to budget appropriately and avoid being underinsured when it matters most. This way, you can budget for your flood insurance premiums and make sure you have the coverage you need. Find the Right Policy at the Right Price: If you’re like most people, you want to get the best flood insurance coverage for the lowest price. By getting a flood insurance quote, you can compare rates and choose a policy that’s right for you. Know the Potential Scope of Your Coverage: It’s essential to know the potential scope of your flood insurance coverage. By getting a flood insurance quote, you can determine how much your policy will cover and make sure you’re fully protected. Work Within Your Budget: Finally, it’s crucial to get a flood insurance quote so you can work within your budget. Having a sound knowledge of the estimates can help you find a policy that fits your needs and budget. Why Choose Neptune Flood Insurance? Protect your home with Neptune Flood, the trusted choice for reliable and affordable flood coverage. Here’s why homeowners nationwide turn to us: Reputable Brand: A name you can trust, backed by years of proven service and satisfied clients. Proven Expertise: Our specialists understand flood risk inside and out, helping you get the right policy for your home. Affordable Coverage: Competitive rates and flexible options make protecting your property easier than ever. Comprehensive Protection: From structural damage to personal belongings, our policies cover what matters most. Inclusive Support Nationwide: No matter your flood risk, we provide guidance and support every step of the way. Take control of your home’s protection, get your personalized flood insurance quote today and secure peace of mind. Frequently Asked Questions How are flood insurance rates calculated? Flood insurance rates are calculated based on your home’s flood risk, which includes factors like FEMA flood zone, elevation, building type, age, coverage amount, deductible, and past flood history. Both NFIP and private insurers use these elements to determine the risk-based cost of insurance. What is the difference between the Neptune Flood Insurance Policy and the NFIP Policy? Neptune offers private flood insurance, providing higher and broader coverage options than those available through the National Flood Insurance Program (NFIP). The NFIP is a government-backed program through the Federal Emergency Management Agency (FEMA) and is limited in the amount of coverage it can offer. For example, an NFIP policy does not provide optional coverage like Temporary Living Expenses or Pool Repair and Refill. I don’t live in a flood zone; do I need flood insurance? Even if you live in a region that is not prone to flooding, it is wise to have flood insurance. Floods can pose a financial risk to anyone. Does my homeowners’ insurance cover any flood damage? Standard homeowners’ insurance does not cover flood damage. Therefore, it is important to know what options are available to protect your assets from flood losses. Can I switch from NFIP to private flood insurance anytime? Yes. You can generally switch from NFIP to private flood insurance at any time, as long as your NFIP policy is active and you don’t have an outstanding claim. It’s important to coordinate the start of your private policy with the cancellation of your NFIP coverage to avoid gaps. What is standard flood insurance coverage? Standard flood insurance coverage typically includes structural protection for your home or building and personal property coverage for belongings inside. It generally covers damage from flooding due to rain, storm surge, or overflowing water, but does not cover sewer backups, earthquakes, or wind damage.

body_text: Organon Announces Quarterly Dividend Save Print July 31, 2026 8:30 am EDT JERSEY CITY, N.J.--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Organon (NYSE: OGN), a global healthcare company with a mission to deliver impactful medicines and solutions for a healthier every day, announced today that the company’s Board of Directors declared a quarterly dividend of $0.02 for each issued and outstanding share of the company's common stock. The dividend is payable on September 10, 2026, to stockholders of record at the close of business on August 14, 2026. About Organon Organon (NYSE: OGN) is a global healthcare company with a mission to deliver impactful medicines and solutions for a healthier every day. Headquartered in Jersey City, New Jersey, Organon is committed to advancing access, affordability, and innovation in healthcare. Learn more at www.organon.com and follow us on LinkedIn , Instagram , X , YouTube , TikTok and Facebook . title: 3M Young Scientist Challenge Names 10 Finalists for 2026 National Competition
summary: Students aged 11 to 14 recognized for innovative robotics, safety and climate solutions; earn chance at title of "America's Top Young Scientist" ST. PAUL, Minn. & CHARLOTTE, N.C., July 6, 2026...
body_text: Students aged 11 to 14 recognized for innovative robotics, safety and climate solutions; earn chance at title of "America's Top Young Scientist" ST. PAUL, Minn. & CHARLOTTE, N.C. , July 6, 2026 / PRNewswire / -- 3M and Discovery Education today announced the 10 finalists in the 2026 3M Young Scientist Challenge, the nation's premier middle school science competition. Now in its 19th year, the annual challenge invites students in fifth through eighth grade to think creatively and apply the power of STEM to develop real-world solutions. Each of the 10 finalists receive an exclusive mentorship with a 3M scientist and at the final event in October, they have the chance to win a $25,000 grand prize and the title of "America's Top Young Scientist." They will work alongside their 3M scientist mentors throughout the summer to gain hands-on experience that will advance the development of their solution. The top 10 2026 3M Young Scientist Challenge finalists are as follows (in alphabetical order by last name): Ahmed Abdelsalam, Cambridge, Mass., Darby Vassall Upper School, Cambridge Public Schools Aaisha Asif, Sarasota, Fla., Pine View, Sarasota County Schools Raji Doshi, Farmington , Conn., Talcott Mountain Academy, Private School Aiden Jo , Houston, Texas, The Village School, Houston Independent School District Roy Kim , Beaverton, Ore., Whitford Middle School, Beaverton School District Arika Kundu , Shorewood, Minn., Minnetonka Middle School East, Minnetonka Public Schools Sharvi Mahajan , San Diego, Calif., Bernardo Heights Middle School, Poway Unified School District Millie Pradawong , Fairfax, Va., Thoreau Middle School, Fairfax County Naboshree Santra , Oviedo, Fla., Jackson Heights Middle School, Seminole County Public Schools Abigail Stein , Nashville, Tenn., Harding Academy, Nashville Independent Schools "The 3M Young Scientist Challenge brings together student curiosity, scientific thinking and 3M mentorship to turn promising ideas into real solutions," said William Brown, 3M Chairman and CEO. "3M is focused on helping these young innovators strengthen their ideas and apply science in ways that can make a meaningful impact." This year's 10 finalists, aged 11 to 14, each spotted an everyday problem, developed an innovative solution, and pitched their project through a one- to two-minute entry video. Their proposals align to two of 3M's 49 technology platforms, including Climate Tech and Safety. An esteemed group of judges, including 3M scientists and leaders in education from across the country, evaluated the entries based on creativity, scientific knowledge and communication effectiveness. "The finalists of this year's 3M Young Scientist Challenge prove you can be a scientist at any age," said Brian Shaw, chief executive officer at Discovery Education. "Each remarkable student pursued their curiosity with persistence, turning an idea into an innovation. We cannot wait to see where their ideas take them." Next steps in the competition Each of the 10 finalists will participate in an exclusive summer mentorship program with a 3M scientist. These mentors will provide guidance and advice to help advance each finalist's solution. Then, on October 12-13, all 10 finalists will gather at the 3M Innovation Center in St. Paul, Minn., to go head-to-head in the final interactive competition. At this final event, each finalist will participate in a series of live challenges before presenting their final project and answering questions from a panel of judges. At the close of the competition, one finalist will be named the grand prize winner, receiving $25,000 and the title of America's Top Young Scientist. Previous competition winners and alumni achievements Previous challenge finalists and 3M scientists have created solutions for a wide variety of real-world problems, including cybersecurity, coral reef health, water conservation, food safety, energy consumption, air pollution and transportation efficiency. Former America's Top Young Scientists have given TED Talks, filed patents and founded nonprofits. In addition, a 3M Young Scientist Challenge Alumni Network was formed in fall 2022 and includes more than 100 former challenge winners, finalists and mentors, who take part in networking opportunities and more. Past honors include: Gitanjali Rao became TIME's first-ever Kid of the Year in 2020 Liam McCarty was named to the Forbes 30 Under 30 list in 2022 Heman Bekele was TIME's 2024 Kid of the Year Learning resources for all educators and students The 3M Young Scientist Challenge is complemented by Young Scientist Lab, a free digital resource program from 3M and Discovery Education that gives every student, regardless of background, access to standards-aligned, hands-on science experiences designed to spark curiosity and build STEM skills. Students, teachers and families of all skill levels can explore, transform and innovate the world around them. Young Scientist Lab resources are also available through Discovery Education Experience, the essential companion for engaged PreK-12 classrooms. To learn more about the 3M Young Scientist Challenge and meet the 2026 finalists, visit YoungScientistLab.com . About 3M 3M (NYSE: MMM) is focused on transforming industries around the world by applying science and creating innovative, customer-focused solutions. Our multi-disciplinary team is working to solve tough customer problems by leveraging diverse technology platforms, differentiated capabilities, global footprint, and operational excellence. Discover how 3M is shaping the future at 3M.com/news . About Discovery Education Discovery Education is a global education technology leader whose innovative solutions empower educators and progress student learning. Discovery Education's solutions have served more than 100 million students globally, supporting effective teaching and learning in 45% of U.S. K-12 schools and in 100+ countries and territories. The company's portfolio includes award-winning core and supplemental curriculum, high-quality standards-aligned content, and AI-enabled teaching and learning tools. Solutions span math, science, literacy, social studies, and career-connected learning, including instructionally-aligned content developed through one-of-a-kind partnerships with industry leaders to bring real-world relevance into every lesson. Learn more at www.DiscoveryEducation.com .
